name: Tattoo Flare
body:
You’ve discovered how to briefly overload your tattoos with magic, generating an intimidating burst of light.

Prerequisite(s): Manipulate Ink , character level 5, must be able to cast spells as a class ability

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you may briefly overload your tattoos with magical energy in order to create a harsh flash of light. Make an Intimidate check against all foes within 30 feet with a circumstance bonus equal to the total number of magical tattoos you possess.
